module: Flowgraph node "Race End Screen" (no category defined). Displays the end-of-race screen (UI route scenario.quickrace.end) with customizable buttons. Inputs: flow, reset (pulse), title, text (string or table), vehId (vehicle whose detailed stats are shown), stats ('endStats' table), plus one string pin per button defined in the editor (the label; empty = button omitted). Outputs: one flow pin per button, true for the clicked one. The first non-retry button is active by default. The detailed times come from core_hotlapping.getTimeInfo() and the best scores from state.raceComepleteHighscores.
notes: Data options: includeRetryButton (true, triggers extensions.hook('onResetGameplay')) and includeScenarioButton (false, adds the 'openScenarios' button).
By default a single 'cont' button is created, with the label "Continue".
The state name "raceComepleteHighscores" (typo) is the one used throughout the highscore nodes' code.
The code contains a leftover comment closed by "]]" in openDialogue (poorly cleaned commented-out code).
A button click runs a Lua command that finds the node again via core_flowgraphManager.getManagerGraphNode(mgrId, graphId, nodeId).

init.desc: Initializes the state (open, done, options) and the data options.

postInit.desc: Creates the default 'cont' button with the label "Continue".

_executionStarted.desc: Sets all outputs to false and resets open/done to false.

drawCustomProperties.desc: Editor panel: rename, delete, add ("add") or remove ("rem") buttons.

updateButtons.desc: Recreates the string input pins and flow output pins for each button of self.options while preserving existing links.

_executionStopped.desc: Closes the dialog if it is open and resets the state.

reset.desc: Resets done and open to false.

buttonPushed.desc: Called by a button click: sets the button's output to true, closes the dialog and marks done.

getCmd.desc: Builds the Lua command string executed by the UI to call buttonPushed(action).

onResetGameplay.desc: Hook: if the screen is open with the Retry button, closes it and marks done (info log).

closeDialogue.desc: Navigates to the UI route 'play' and marks the screen closed.

onClientEndMission.desc: Mission end hook: sets open = false.

openDialogue.desc: Builds the buttons and the stats (title, detailed times, highscores) then navigates to scenario.quickrace.end.

closed.desc: Sets done = true (closing signaled by the UI).

work.desc: Handles reset and opens the dialog on first flow as long as done is false.
